data.spiritual_meaning: The name Zenah holds spiritual significance in the Islamic tradition as it is derived from the name of Prophet Zain, a descendant of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The name is a reminder of the importance of inner beauty and character.
data.numerology_meaning: The name Zenah is considered auspicious in numerology as the sum of its alphabetic values equals 3, which represents creativity, self-expression, and communication.
